Class TransportIngest

java.lang.Object
global.thalion.ttio.transport.TransportIngest
public final class TransportIngest extends Object
Callback-driven incremental transport-stream parser. Sits next to TransportReader: where the reader assumes you have the whole stream up front and want every packet back at once, the ingest is for callers (e.g. the TTI-O Workbench Server's WebSocket upload session) that feed bytes in chunks as they arrive and want each packet delivered as soon as it's complete.

Lifecycle:

TransportIngest ingest = new TransportIngest(new TransportIngest.Listener() {
    public void onPacket(TransportIngest.PacketRecord rec) { ... }
    public void onEndOfStream() { ... }
    public void onError(TransportIngest.IngestException e) { ... }
});
// ... when bytes arrive ...
ingest.feed(chunk);   // listener fires per packet
// ... on producer EOF ...
ingest.finish();      // throws if trailing partial

Validates everything TransportReader validates — magic, version, header CRC, payload CRC when the PacketHeader.FLAG_HAS_CHECKSUM flag is set, AU-sequence monotonicity, StreamHeader-first — but does so packet-by-packet instead of in one pass. A failed validation halts the ingest; the rolling buffer is discarded and any subsequent feed(byte[]) throws TransportIngest.IngestException.

Not thread-safe: a single ingest instance must be driven from one thread. The server pattern is one ingest per WS connection, owned by the worker thread that accepted the connection.

Cross-language equivalents:

  • Objective-C: TTIOTransportIngest
  • Python: ttio.transport.ingest.TransportIngest

    • packetCount

      public long packetCount()
      Total packets emitted so far. Useful for resumable-upload progress reporting.

    • bufferedBytes

      public int bufferedBytes()
      Bytes currently buffered awaiting a complete packet.

    • isFinished

      public boolean isFinished()
      true once the ingest has received and emitted an EndOfStream packet, or has been put into the failed state by a parse error. Further feed(byte[]) calls on a finished ingest throw TransportIngest.IngestException.

    • feed

      public void feed(byte[] data)
      Feed a chunk of transport bytes.

      As packets complete, delivers each to TransportIngest.Listener.onPacket(PacketRecord) synchronously on the calling thread. Throws TransportIngest.IngestException on the first parse error; TransportIngest.Listener.onError(IngestException) is also invoked in that case (so callers may choose either failure-handling style).

    • feed

      public void feed(byte[] data, int offset, int length)
      Feed a slice of a byte array.

    • finish

      public void finish()
      Signal end-of-input.

      If the rolling buffer contains a partial packet (header without payload, payload without CRC, …) throws TransportIngest.IngestException and fires the error callback. If the last successfully parsed packet was EndOfStream this is a no-op.
